taskTypes.description: Fixed held time that's never checked off, e.g. commute, an appointment, work hours.

trackingTypes.description: Simple did-it-or-not habit — the default when trackingType is omitted.
An amount per day. Needs target (number) and unit.
Minutes spent. Needs target and unit "min".
A number of repetitions. Needs target and unit.
A fixed sequence of steps. Needs steps: string[].

actionTypes.description: A brand-new plan (with or without recurring tasks/milestones).
A recurring daily/weekly habit not tied to a specific plan's task list.
A single task, commitment, or session — one-off or recurring, optionally attached to an existing plan by name.
Adding steps/subtasks to a task the user already has.
A numeric goal/metric to track under an existing plan.
Milestones for a plan the user already has.
Not a write — a question back to the user when the target plan/task is ambiguous or unnamed.
